title: Generation Failure Mode Triage
description: A triage exercise in which learners match eight defective AI-generated MicroSims, each with a symptom, a picture of the defect and an optional simulated console message, to one of six generation failure modes, then read the cause, the first repair and the evidence that separates similar modes.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Debugging AI-Generated Code
Generation Failure Modes
MicroSim Quality
Instructional Technology
publisher: MicroSims 2.0: Generating, Instrumenting and Evaluating Interactive Learning Objects with AI

educational.topic: Generation failure modes of AI-written MicroSim code
learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish generation failure modes by matching a described symptom to its most likely cause and first repair.
prerequisites: MicroSim layout: drawing region, control region and iframe height (Chapter 2)

technical.instrumentation: All interactions pass through logInteraction(verb, extra), which appends to interactionLog and dispatches a 'microsim-interaction' CustomEvent on window. Verbs: viewed-case, opened-console, selected, answered.

controls.label: Next case
controls.action: Load the next of eight defective-MicroSim cases

controls.label: Show console
controls.action: Reveal or hide the simulated browser console for the case

controls.label: Check
controls.action: Check the selected failure-mode card and show cause, first repair and distinguishing evidence

canvasInteractions: Click a failure-mode card to select it
Hover a card to read its definition

assumptions: Each case has one most likely failure mode
Console messages are simulated in Chrome's format

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Case-based diagnosis with immediate, contrastive feedback
keyQuestions: What evidence separates a hallucinated API from library version drift?
What does a clean console tell you?
Is the defect on the right edge, the bottom edge, or inside the drawing?
commonMisconceptions: Every console error is a hallucinated API
Clipped controls always mean the canvas is too small
A clean console means the code is correct
assessmentOpportunities: Written justification of one diagnosis with evidence
